approved_scope.title: 70c-1: Rust joins a room over a real Hybrid session the way TypeScript does, from a shared vector
approved_scope.description: 70c-1: Rust joins a room over a real Hybrid session the way TypeScript does, from a shared vector
acceptance_criteria: cargo test --locked passes in rs/ and inside the unpacked algochat .crate, where tests/room_session.rs shows from the TypeScript-generated vectors/room-session-v1.json that: each account's address, X25519 key and ML-KEM key come from its seed; reduce_admin accepts the create and both add records and gives the same owner, members, epoch and head as TypeScript; each member recovers its session from the owner's 0x04 handshake with its own seed, and the owner recovers the same session from the note as sender; each member opens its 227-byte 0x06 action-5 delivery to the room key, group id, mailbox and epoch, and delivery_authorized accepts it against the accepted records; every 0x07 message from the owner and both members opens with per-sender replay state, and a repeated (sender, epoch, counter) is rejected; the outsider's note opens under the key but sender_may_post refuses it; and every open_delivery, authorize and open_message case gives the same accepted or rejected result. bun test in ts/ shows the committed vector is exactly what ts/scripts/emit-room-session-vector.ts writes and that every case holds in TypeScript. CRATE-8 to CRATE-12 are in hi/crate.md exactly as Leif approved them. No library, API or wire change.
